reasoning_content:
Now I'm going to start the Keycloak container. Create the admin user and start it. Note: 7.6GB of RAM available, Keycloak needs about 512MB.

Start the container with a fixed port 8080. To avoid the complexity of startup commands, use startup=dev or the default. In reality, Keycloak runs in "start-dev" mode by default in recent versions. Let's create the admin user with KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME/PASSWORD environment variables.

action.command: docker run -d --name keycloak -p 8080:8080 -e KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME=admin -e KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin -e KEYCLOAK_IMPORT=/tmp/strassennamen-realm.json quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.4.6 start-dev 2>&1 | tail -2

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "docker run -d --name keycloak -p 8080:8080 -e KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME=admin -e KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin -e KEYCLOAK_IMPORT=/tmp/strassennamen-realm.json quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.4.6 start-dev 2>&1 | tail -2", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Start Keycloak container on port 8080"}
